$comment: Canonical Vietnamese terminology for the HealthCare patient-facing UI (Advisor WS1). Enforced by apps/frontend/tests/terminology-contract.test.mjs. Banned-string matching is case-sensitive on the exact listed forms, which are the button/label/CTA shapes; lowercase mid-sentence uses of a word are reviewed per surface, not by this list.

assistant.usage: The product name for the in-portal AI assistant (login copy, patient portal nav).
assistant.note: The floating widget keeps the accessible name 'Trợ lý sức khỏe' (pinned by tests/e2e/floating-assistant.spec.ts); that is the widget's name, not this term.

publicAssistantCta.usage: Default label of PublicAiButton on public pages — an action ('symptom advice'), not a product name.

appointmentEntity.usage: The booked appointment as an entity (lists, lookup codes, notification copy).
appointmentEntity.exceptionUsage: Visit-oriented section copy on the patient dashboard where 'upcoming visit' is the meaning.

bookingCta.usage: The single booking call-to-action everywhere (Navbar, Footer mobile rail, homepage quick cards, /dat-lich branch cards, PublicBookingButton default).

dismissal.usage: Modal/dialog dismissal button and dismiss aria-labels.

banned.scope: User-facing naming of the product. Lowercase 'chatbot' inside safety disclaimers ('đây không phải chatbot') describes the generic concept and is out of scope.

banned.replacedBy: Tư vấn triệu chứng (public CTA) / Trợ lý AI (product name)
banned.scope: The old product-style name. Lowercase mid-sentence variants ('Hỏi trợ lý triệu chứng' children overrides) remain on pages outside the WS1 safe set and are a follow-up.
Banned specifically as a booking CTA label. The noun 'lịch hẹn' stays canonical for the appointment entity.

banned.replacedBy: Bỏ hẳn — nhãn tiếng Việt thuần (Nội dung chi tiết / Nội dung bài viết y khoa)
banned.scope: English parenthetical suffix on Vietnamese editor labels (round-10 matrix screenshot m3-doc10). Applies to label/heading text; code identifiers and API field names are unaffected.
